node: Housing repair/remodel contractor supply, specialty distributors, restoration products, equipment rental, and dealer networks
summary: Expanded the node around housing repair/remodel capacity rather than end-consumer demand. The strongest underfollowed mappings are companies that control contractor access, service dispatch, specialty rental capacity, or local branch density. The list intentionally avoids homebuilder-only cyclicals and focuses on second-order beneficiaries where repair, replacement, storm/restoration, maintenance, or contractor productivity can matter more than new-home starts.
